title: Rav Shmuel of Difta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat 22a, disputing with Rav Acha, son of Rava. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Yirmiyah of Difta; Hyman says the name became Shmuel through an error prompted by the word mi-smol, “on the left.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading remains Shmuel of Difta. Hyman attributes Yirmiyah of Difta to דק״ס, conventionally Dikdukei Soferim, and explains Shmuel as a corruption prompted by משמאל, mi-smol, “on the left.” The mechanism is his textual explanation, not an independently established reading history.
Shabbat 22a follows the printed כב. locator. Rav Acha is called the son of Rava; this relationship and the name Rava remain distinct from the subject.
